description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ValidationDecorator' which provides helper methods to add validation rules to parameter rules within an API validation context for the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: ValidationDecorator
classes.description: Provides methods to decorate parameter rules with required or not-required validation rules, supporting composite validation logic.

methods.name: requiredParamRule
methods.description: Adds 'required' validation rules to a given ParamRule, optionally excluding empty strings.

methods.name: notRequiredParamRule
methods.description: Adds 'not required' validation rules to a given ParamRule, with control over whether empty strings are considered acceptable.
